subject: Temporary preservation & evidence request: tenant logs and session traces
messages:
From: Sam Torres <sam.torres@ehealthco.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-04-16T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request for temporary preservation of tenant logs and session traces

Hi Karthik,

We have an internal compliance review at eHealthCo and need Redwood's help to preserve a small set of artifacts for a 90-day investigation window. The impacted tenant is ehealthco-prod (tenant id: ehc-prod-3). Specifically we need:

- All inference request/response traces for tenant ehc-prod-3 from 2028-03-01 to present (including prompt text and model variant metadata)
- Session-level activity logs (session IDs, timestamps, IPs) for the same period
- Any KV-cache snapshot artifacts tied to that tenant

We understand Redwood's default rolling log retention is 30 days. Legal is asking for a temporary preservation hold while we determine scope. Please advise:
1) What artifacts you can preserve in-place without a tenant export?
2) If a snapshot/export is required, what does the format look like and how long can Redwood host it?
3) Any SOC 2 / CAIQ mapping or evidence we should include with our legal hold request to expedite review.

Pamela (cc'd) is eHealthCo legal and will follow up with a signed legal-hold if needed. We're on an upcoming audit cycle and would appreciate an answer by EOD 2028-04-17 if possible.

Thanks,
Sam Torres
Senior Security Program Manager
eHealthCo

Attachments referenced: none in this first message

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Torres <sam.torres@ehealthco.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-04-16T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request for temporary preservation of tenant logs and session traces

Hi Sam — thanks for the clear scope. Short answer up front: we can accommodate a temporary preservation for the artifacts you listed, with a few constraints and an evidence checklist for your legal hold.

High level options (summary attached): retention-options-summary.pdf
- In-place preservation: we can mark tenant ehc-prod-3 for a preservation flag that prevents automated deletion for up to 90 days. This retains both request/response traces and session metadata in our primary telemetry store.
- Export snapshot: we can produce a time-bounded export (NDJSON, CSV for metadata, and zstd-compressed request payload bundle). We typically host exported snapshots for 30 days unless a retention extension is contracted.

Information we need from you to proceed quickly:
1) Signed legal-hold or incident preservation affidavit (scanned PDF) referencing tenant ehc-prod-3 and the requested date range.
2) Confirmation of whether PII should be redacted in the exported payloads (if you need redaction we will provide a redaction plan and timeline).
3) Which specific model variants and route names to include (if you want to exclude low-signal debug routes to reduce size).
4) Point of contact for chain-of-custody and where exported snapshots should be staged (S3 bucket, secure share, or we can host temporarily).

Operational notes:
- Default preserved fields: timestamp, request_id, session_id, model_name, model_version, prompt_text (will be redacted only by explicit request), response_text, client_ip hash, route_name, kv-cache-id.
- For Private deployments (VPC/on-prem), preservation is customer-managed and we provide an evidence bundle; for hosted Dedicated/Hosted customers we apply the preservation flag centrally.
- When preservation flag is set, it may increase storage footprint and cost; we'll provide a cost estimate once we have the expected data volume.

I've looped in Priyom from Product (cc) to help with export formatting and Marissa from Security for SOC 2/CAIQ evidence mapping if Pamela wants that. If you can send the signed hold, we'll start a 72-hour intake to scope size and provide timelines.

- Karthik
Director, Customer Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments: retention-options-summary.pdf (one-page summary, formats and timelines)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: Request for temporary preservation of tenant logs and session traces

Pamela / Sam — got the signed hold, thanks. Confirming our plan and timeline below.

Scope to preserve (in-place preservation flag applied to ehc-prod-3):
- Inference request/response traces: 2028-03-01 to 2028-04-18 (full payloads, retained unredacted)
- Session activity logs (session id, timestamps, client_ip hash, route_name) for same period
- KV-cache snapshot references for any active caches tied to ehc-prod-3

Operational timeline:
- Intake & sizing: 48-72 hours after receipt of legal-hold (completed by 2028-04-20 EOD)
- Preservation flag applied: within 24 hours of intake completion
- Export (if requested): NDJSON & CSV bundle, estimated export ready within 5 business days post-intake; hosted snapshot retention default 30 days (can extend with contract)

CAIQ / SOC 2 evidence:
- Marissa (cc) will produce a deviation addendum that maps the tenant-specific preservation to the relevant CAIQ questions and SOC 2 control objectives (we will include who approved the hold, time bounds, and whether data redaction occurred). Expect initial evidence bundle within 5 business days after intake.

Cost & accounting:
- We'll provide an estimated storage surcharge once we size the data. Preliminary estimate is $X/day per GB; we will not proceed with extended hosting beyond 30 days without explicit acceptance of the surcharge or a contract amendment.

Next steps required from eHealthCo:
1) Confirm you want in-place preservation (yes/no).
2) If you want exported snapshots, confirm destination for staging (S3 vs Redwood-hosted).
3) Provide a named point of contact for export delivery and chain-of-custody acceptance.

I'll schedule a 30-minute triage call tomorrow to walk through the intake checklist unless you prefer to proceed by email.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Customer Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
